title: Sebastian and the Hollow
author: Freya Vasquez
blurb: Gideon Delacroix, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
